section_summary.extract_value: This section details the measures used in the study. Goal orientation was assessed using VandeWalle's (1997) 13-item instrument, differentiating learning, prove, and avoidance goal orientations. Performance was objectively rated based on videotaped task completion units by experimenters and a second rater, with good interrater agreement (average Cohen's Kappa of .79). Tasks were categorized into easy, medium, and difficult complexity levels, with analyses focusing on medium and difficult tasks.
